source: Trailer towing, farm attachment plan step A2 (farming_sim docs/farm/PLAN.md section 6, vault FARM-003). The coupling itself is physics_sim's (ps::machine, hitch classes, tow brake, articulation limits); this file is what the GAME decides on top: which hitch classes the player can couple, how close a hook-up has to be, how fast the vehicles may move, when a hitch lets go, the trailer kinds with their load states and the advice texts. Tags: [C] cited, [D] derived, [M] measured here, [AS] assumed (owner values go in the same keys).
channel_scope_help: The trailer's control channels are "trailer.brake" and so on (World::vehicle_channel); the car keeps the bare names the whole game uses. The tow brake of the trailer file reads the car's "brake" channel in the car's own scope.
limit_policy_help: The physics_sim limit policy that grades the hitch ratings (TowedMass, TongueLoad: hitch_near_share / hitch_limiting_share / hitch_exceeded_share). The same file the garage advisor uses; the player's own layer is merged there.

hookup.assist_help: true: a hook-up within reach_m puts the trailer where its eye meets the tow point (a shift in plan and a pitch about its axles, the way a person winds the jack and walks the trailer onto the ball) and then couples; false: the sockets must already be inside the hitch class's latch limits (ball 0.15 m, drawbar pin 0.10 m).
hookup.reach_source: [AS] a person can walk a trailer on its jack wheel a few metres; a little more than spawn.gap_m, which leaves the ball-to-coupler height difference inside it.
hookup.max_heading_source: [AS] the trailer's nose points roughly the way the car does; a hitch's yaw stop is 75-90 degrees, the assist keeps well inside it.
hookup.max_speed_source: [D] the hitch classes' own latch speed limit (data/hitch_classes/*.json, latch.max_speed_m_s 0.5) - the car, the trailer and their sockets.
hookup.max_vertical_source: [M] the stroke of the trailer's jack (external/physics_sim/data/models/trailer_tipper/trailer_tipper.rig.json, node jack: 0 to 0.32 m) - the nose height the assist may change.

unhook.max_speed_source: [AS] a trailer is let go standing, not rolling; the car's speed above this refuses the request with a message.

spawn.gap_source: [AS] a standing trailer is put with its eye this far behind the car's tow point: inside the hook-up reach, outside the bumper.

abandon.distance_source: [AS] the physics terrain around the car is 400 m; a standing trailer left further behind than this would fall through ground that is no longer there, so it is removed (a parked-trailer fleet is a later step).
abandon.relocation_keep_source: [AS] after a relocation (reset, flip, teleport) a coupled trailer comes along and is hooked on again behind the car; a standing one stays only if the car landed this close to it, else it is removed.

brake_when_standing_source: [AS] a parking brake on a standing trailer; the physics has no breakaway brake (hitch.md), so a trailer that comes off in motion also gets it.

classes.name: ball
classes.label: tow ball
classes.source: [AS] a car's tow ball. The hitch lets go when the force on it stays above 4 x the ISO 7641-1 D value of the pair for 50 ms (a coupling is tested at about 2 x D alternating; physics_sim's articulation limit can push 300-730 kN into the pair under brake plus lock - that is what this rule turns into an event instead of a number).

classes.name: drawbar_pin
classes.label: drawbar pin
classes.source: [AS] a tractor's drawbar pin, heavier than a ball.

loads.label: empty
loads.source: [AS] a 14 t tandem rear tipper trailer with its bed and ram, unladen; 14 t gross is the rig's description.

loads.label: full load
loads.source: [M] the gross mass of external/physics_sim/data/models/trailer_tipper/trailer_tipper.rig.json (14 t) and its vehicle fixture's spring set.

jack.foot_source: [D] rig jack pivot (4.1, 0, 0.27) with the leg 0.25 m down (the foot reaches the ground at 0.25), moved to the chassis origin with the visual's offset (x - 0.45, z - 1.13); 2 cm of preload below the empty trailer's rest height.
jack.spec_source: [AS] a parking leg: about 8 mm of give under the empty trailer's 4 kN nose weight.

trailers.model_offset_source: [D] the rig origin (ground below the wheel centres, x midway between the axles) in the chassis frame: the wheel pivot (0.8, 0.95, 0.62) minus its attachment (0.35, 0.95, -0.51) in data/vehicles/trailer_tipper.json - the same arithmetic vehicle_visual.gd does for a car.
